Subject: Proposed demo windows for week of Mar 29 — DST note

Hi Alex & Sofia,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. We had tentatively penciled a 45-minute product demo for the week of Mar 29. One thing to flag: the US switched to DST on Mar 8, while many EU locations switch on Mar 29 — there will be a one-week mismatch that can make convenient slots trickier.

To avoid confusion for attendees across US/EU/APAC, could you confirm whether BrightBank prefers:
- A) a time that lands early-morning EU / late-afternoon US (we can add a 30–45 minute buffer), or
- B) two shorter regional sessions (one for US/APAC, one for EU) — we can run the EU session the following week if preferable.

Below are candidate windows (all durations 45m):
- Wed Mar 31: 09:00 CET / 00:00 PDT (not ideal for US)
- Thu Mar 25: 16:00 PDT / 00:00 CET (works for US evening and EU late night)
- Fri Mar 26: 10:00 PDT / 18:00 CET (evening EU)

If you prefer, we can send a short timezone matrix and mark a conservative 60-minute slot to account for clock-change confusion. I attached a brief demo agenda for reference.

Best,
Connor O'Brien

connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (425) 555-0192

Connor — thanks for the heads up.

BrightBank will have stakeholders in London and New York on this call. The London team is sensitive to late-evening slots; they prefer before 18:00 local time. With EU switching on the 29th, we do have that narrow week where the offset will shift and people are already juggling calendars.

Option A (single slot with buffer) sounds best for us if you can guarantee a clear calendar invite and a 15–30 minute buffer for start/end times. Could you propose a conservative slot that keeps London before 18:00 and still workable for New York? Our NYC folks are OK with 13:00–16:00 EDT.

Also: can you add the calendar invite in both CET and EDT so invites show properly for everyone?

Thanks,
